name: Liquid Dusk
description: Hot pink and amber over a deep indigo night, with a cobalt third hue for decorative fields. Dark only.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: Anchored from the flux direction in the owner's ten-variant report (2026-10-25), derived by anchor-v2, with an emphasis anchor for the decorative third hue (S1).

fallbacks: It has one base mode, dark, and locks every display mode to it: an indigo night has no daylight. High contrast is derived by high-contrast-v2, and print renders the high-contrast light set.
